items.title: 63477_Joe Darensbourg oral history interview
items.q: One was named Black Benny and one was named Green.

ctx.x: His last name was Brock. I can't think of his first name. Anyway, Sheffield stayed in there and had a drink maybe, or whatever, and just left, and didn't bother us. But they had two other detectives. One was named Black Benny and one was named Green. They was kind of rough, too. But nobody had a reputation like Sheffield. But Benny and Green would wheel and deal. They were strictly on the take.
You were saying about Hamp, you thought Hamp might have been playing with the band. I know when he first started his career, he started playing with Andrew Blake,
